release_notes: Facebook tracking resilience + full metric parity. Auto-heal for malformed query strings: a double '?' (Facebook Ads URL-parameters box with a leading '?', or a cloaker concatenating onto a URL that already had one) corrupted the first routing parameter and lost the click — healing now runs BEFORE campaign routing in all 3 entry points, repairs the corrupted value and recovers every swallowed key (utm_placement is now captured too). Campaign editor gains a 'Facebook Parameters' copy button (clean parameter string, no leading '?') for Meta Ads Manager, and Direct-URL streams get an 'Add All Tracking Parameters' preset; unresolved {macros} are stripped from redirect URLs so literals never reach the affiliate network. Cloak observability (full spec): every routing decision is now persisted and visible in the panel — clicks carry cloak_verdict/reasons/is_safe_page plus ISP/ASN/proxy facts, Analytics→Clicks shows Route/Reason/Destination/ISP/ASN columns with filters; safe-page clicks are LOGGED by default (is_safe_page=1) and excludable from reports via exclude_safe_from_reports, a per-day suppressed-hit counter guarantees 'zero clicks' can never hide real traffic; geo-targeting safety: missing-geo-DB traffic is marked geo_unknown with a configurable action, and the editor + Geo Databases page warn when filters run without a database. Landings/Offers report parity: registrations, deposits, bots/proxies, per-status revenue and the real-revenue family are actually computed now (previously always 0, real_roi showed a bogus -100%); both pages get the customizable metric table with per-page presets and totals. Stream rotation honors per-item disable toggles (a paused offer inside a custom schema no longer receives traffic). Locales at full parity in all 7 languages; Chrome-extension floating widget remembers its position. AFTER UPDATING, HARD-RELOAD THE PANEL ONCE (Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+R) — index.js has a stable filename and browsers cache the old build.
